quest.title: Gazing Three Thousand Miles Away
quest.description: Chouji, a young land selling ore on Yashiori Island, seems to be hiding an unfathomable secret...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: People from abroad, come and have a look! This is the best Jakotsu Crystal in Yashiori Island!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: C'mon, check it out! Goods of this quality used to go straight to the Shogunate. Get it at a discount here, Adventurers, and you'll be making weapons that'll cut through steel like butter in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How much is it?

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Well, let me see... Five crystals for 300,000 Mora, 15 crystals for 900,000 Mora, a batch of 30 crystals for... 1.8 million Mora. Thanks for your patronage!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Might as well commit daylight robbery!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Haha, I get it. For you outlanders, so far away from home, it's gotta be hard to part with your Mora.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: After all, the mine's been shut down because of the war, and there's this Tatarigami or whatever causing a nuisance on the island. That's what the grown-ups say anyway...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well, my own supplies are running low. Scarcity drives prices up, y'know?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Besides, this stuff contains a "risk premium," too~

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Risk premium"? What do you mean?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What does "risk premium" even mean...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well... I'm a kid making money like an adult, so I run the risk of discovery by the Tenryou Commission — that's what I mean by "risk premium"!

choices.text: Ah, so that's how it is.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: It's fine if you don't want to buy it right now. I'll be around here anytime should you change your mind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This kid speaks all funny...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What about your parents?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: They're doing great, thank you for asking!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: My parents are both miners. Mined these crystals in my hands themselves, in fact! In the past, the foreman would collect everyone's ore and give it to the big shots in the city. Shove 'em all into boxes to be transported to Tatarasuna.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: But now that we're at war, the adults in the city won't be coming this way anymore...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: So we have to sell our own ore and earn our own Mora!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: See, such high-quality ore like this used to go straight to the Shogunate. Now, even adventurers like yourself can buy these unblemished gems, and at a fair price too!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: And I get to make Mora just like grown-ups. Guess this war ain't all bad, eh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, was this kid born an optimist, or is there something here that Paimon's not seeing?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Hmm, oh right... Can I ask you to help me with something?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Hehe, I mean, you look like a nice person. Someone a kid like me can trust, y'know?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Besides, they've got this saying in Liyue, don't they? "The deal may be off, but our honor still stands." And we Inazuman samurai are the most honorable people there are!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, isn't this little fella full of surprises...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: You see, the mines have been closed due to recent events.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: And those crystals are too hard and heavy... I can't collect them myself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, didn't you say that you wanted to make Mora like an adult?

choices.text: You meant "make money off other people's labor" like an adult.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Hehe, you sure got me there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ha, even you admit it!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: That's right, 12 pieces, please!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who's going to help you, huh? You slippery little brat!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Don't get mad, I'll make it worth your while. There's stuff in it for you, too!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: When we sell the crystals, we'll split the earnings fifty-fifty!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And you'll sell them, how?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well, if you don't want to wait... How about this, then? I'll sell you the crystals you mined for half the price, and we'll split my earnings fifty-fifty!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I mean, I'll be making a loss! What do you say? You've never seen such an awesome deal in your life, am I right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's never seen a businessman this shameless, more like...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Hmm, in that case, I'll just have to resort to "that"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And what's "that"?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Treasure! A chest full of treasure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! Treasure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh yeah... that's true, you're right, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, show it to us first then, or Paimon won't believe a word of it!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I can't.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So what are you trying to sell us, here?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Calm down! What I mean is that there's so much treasure and it's so heavy that I can't carry it all by myself...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: But I can tell you where it's hidden! You can trust me.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: What do you say? You interested?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This kid seems super shady no matter how you look at this... but if there's treasure to be had...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #It'd be a shame to give it up... What do you say, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Relax, I wouldn't lie to you!

choices.text: So you want us to mine for you, then?
Would you take a Paimon for those goods?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! What's that supposed to mean?

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: You're back. Do you have the crystals with you?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: No hurry, stay safe now!

talks.objective: Give the Crystal Marrow to Chouji

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Thank you, these will do!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright then, time to tell us where the treasure is.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Okay. The treasure is just next to the mine. You'll find it, easy-peasy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Thanks! C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's go!

talks.objective: Obtain the treasure mentioned by Chouji

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, you little liar!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Ugh... Oh, I'll be honest with you. We're a mining family, so we were already very poor. And now that all these things have happened, life's gotten even harder...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I'm just a poor boy from a poor family. I've never seen a large sum of Mora in my life...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Those things I gave you are the only precious treasures I have...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, if I may ask...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Go on...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How much do 30 pieces of crystal cost...?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: 1.8 million Mora!

choices.text: And he says he's never, ever seen a large sum of Mora...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well, see... It's not like what you think!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I... I can really only give you this much...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* You...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon, you tell him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kids should act like kids! They shouldn't be learning all these bad behaviors from grown-ups...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I'm not a kid anymore!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So is that why you learned how to scam people like the grown-ups do?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I... But...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You must have seen grown-ups lie and cheat to make money, and to manipulate others to do as they wish, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But those are terrible people... They only know how to satisfy themselves by hurting other people.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You don't wanna hurt other people, do you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't know what you've experienced...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But that's terrible behavior! No one likes being cheated or used!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Especially greedy, simple-minded people.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah! Especially... Hey... Who are you talking about, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, come on, Paimon was talking! Anyway, if you really need help, we'll think of ways to help you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you shouldn't cheat people like that, you understand?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You'd make a good teacher, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon's learned a thing or three from traveling with you, don't ya think?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: ...Okay, I got it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Yup. I won't lie to you anymore... but...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: But will you really help me?

choices.text: As long as you really do need help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Only if you stop scamming people!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Okay... Then I won't waste any more of your time, I guess.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: See you again. Have a safe trip!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Paimon wonders if he really took in a word we said.

choices.text: So long as the compensation's fair.
You've got quite the appetite, huh?

talks.objective: Rest until 11:00 – 14:00 the next day and talk to Chouji

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Hmmm... You don't seem to have had that much experience in the kitchen, but the food's still really good. Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmph, {NICKNAME}'s culinary skill needs no praise! Hey, save some for Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Wow, didn't expect to see you again. Hello there!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Are you here to buy crystals today, too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Just call me {NICKNAME}, kiddo.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #Okay, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Come have a look at today's crystals. These were supposed to go straight to Tatarasuna!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: You won't be disappointed, trust me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fool Paimon twice, shame on Paimon!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Hehe~

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Geez, this kid is awful!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you've been selling ore alone here this whole time?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Yeah! I grew up, and started making Mora! Only kids are scared of being alone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But didn't you that say your parents are here too?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Yup. They're somewhere safe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, is that so...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Paimon, it's best not to ask.)

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #So, {NICKNAME}, you promised to help me before, didn't you?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #Could you... mine some more crystals for me, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Which you'll then sell at a high price, I trust?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Yeah...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, what are we now, free labor?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: N—No, it's not like that... I just...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I really do need Mora...

choices.text: And what do you need that Mora for?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well, I've got various reasons. Which I'll tell you for sure, don't you worry! I just need you to help me out, please?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Okay, thank you so much! I'll be waiting right here!

choices.text: We'd like to hear your explanation all the same.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Not bad. Thanks for your concern!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: It used to be pretty lively on the island, but ever since the war started, everyone's moved out... even the mine's all empty now.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Some moved north, others went south, and no one's come back yet... It's so quiet now.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: But that's not necessarily a bad thing, huh? It's annoying with too many little kiddos around, and I'm not a kid anymore... I mean, adults should look after themselves and make their own fun, right?

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}, you're back. Did you bring the crystals?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: No hurry, stay safe now!

talks.objective: Give the Crystal Marrow to Chouji

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Thank you! That should be enough.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, where's that explanation we wanted?

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Uhh... What explanation?

choices.text: What do you need the Mora for?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I wanna leave this island.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: People either left or got sick... There aren't many people on Yashiori Island anymore.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: ...I don't want to have to fight every day. I don't want to be surrounded by all this Tatarigami... I wanna get away from here. Leave this island.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And what about your parents?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, are you going to leave your parents alone here?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Like I said... They're in a safe place.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #...{NICKNAME}, could we talk about this unhappy stuff later?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Haha, don't worry. I won't run away.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #How about this then... If you've got time, {NICKNAME}, you should come over to my place. We can continue our talk there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Don't just leave! We haven't said anything yet!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This kid is so presumptuous!

choices.text: What do you need those crystals for?

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! I didn't think you'd actually come...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: How is it? Not bad, huh?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Oh, I'm so sorry! I invited you to my house, but I forgot to cook... Sorry, that's my bad.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Not that I've got much left now other than Lavender Melon...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I'm used to eating those, but I can't just serve them to guests...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well, just a moment, please. I'll go collect some ingredients so that I can make something for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon's not waiting around for that. We'll come along and help!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: But you're my guests. I...

choices.text: It's fine. I'm used to helping.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Okay. So, here's my family recipe for Imported Poultry. Please have a look.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: This dish was originally taught to us by Xavier, who's an outlander in the Shogunate. According to him, it's well-suited to miners who need to replenish their energy!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: We've got enough Lavender Melon at home, so you don't have to give me any of those. We've got Wheat, too, which can be ground into Flour.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: But since we're going to make a poultry dish, we need some Fowl. We'll also need some Bird Eggs as a side dish.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #They aren't rare ingredients, but with the current conditions on Yashiori Island... If you don't mind, {NICKNAME}, please help me gather these ingredients.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Sorry for troubling you like this. You're supposed to be my guests...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, it's fine! No need to be so polite!

choices.text: Just a little exercise before the meal.
Gotta say, I'm a little peckish...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *rumble*...Paimon's hungry too...

talks.objective: Learn how to make Imported Poultry

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're back!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: All right, let's not dilly-dally any longer. Let's make us some Imported Poultry!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hooray for Imported Poultry!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hooray for Imported Poultry!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Hooray for Imported Poultry!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Haha, alright. Now, let me introduce the recipe to you!

choices.text: Just some simple instructions will do.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: You see, it's that simple!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're a pretty talented cook, Chouji.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon didn't know you were such a good cook, either! Ooh, Paimon's stomach is already rumbling just listening to those instructions.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well, this is the recipe my mom taught me. It's her signature dish.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Hehe, let's try and make it, shall we?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: My mom always used to teach me to cook. This is the first time that I'm teaching someone else!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're a great adventurer, right? I'm sure this Imported Poultry is just a piece of cake for you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, Paimon's mad now, he's looking down on us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, we'll show him!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: This dish is very easy to make! First, let's cut the Lavender Melon and boil it in water. Then, we crack the Bird Eggs and beat them.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: If you're confident enough with a knife, you can cut the melons into any shape you like!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Next, put the Fowl on the chopping board and slice it down the middle into thick pieces. Then, we need to marinate it for a while...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: After that, we'll dredge the sliced Fowl through the flour... If there's too much flour, remember to pat it off. Then, we coat the Fowl evenly using the beaten eggs.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Heat the oil — and don't forget to use a chopstick to test the temperature. You'll know it's ready once you see small bubbles gushing up from the chopstick.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Then, put the slices that have been wrapped in flour into the pan and deep fry them for, um, three to four minutes. Turn the heat up until the skin turns golden, and then you can take them out.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Don't heat the oil too much, or else it'll be overcooked. But if it's not hot enough, the oil will seep into the skin and make it soft, which will make it taste horrible.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Take the deep-fried Fowl out and put it on top of paper to soak up the extra oil. Then cut it into strips.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Finally, decorate it with lavender melon, add some homemade sauce... and we're done!

talks.objective: Share the dish you made with Chouji

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: What we'll need is some <color=#00E1FFFF>Flour</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Fowl</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>Bird Eggs</color>. Just ask me any time if you forget!

talks.objective: Ask Chouji about the taste of the dish

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #Mm~mm! That's yummy! {NICKNAME}, you have the potential to become a famous chef!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wow, it smells good! You know what, {NICKNAME}, why don't we just open a gourmet kiosk here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's being serious!

talks.objective: Ask Chouji about the taste of the dish
Ask Chouji about the taste of the dish

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Uh... Ahaha, I've got to say that I've never tasted such... outlandish flavors in my life.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Outlandish flavors? More like Abyssal ones!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, Chouji, don't force yourself! You're still a kid. You don't have to eat this stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Thank you. I haven't had this dish for a long time. My mom used to cook this for me. It was so delicious... no one could make it as well as her.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Well, now I wish I wasn't stuck eating lavender melon every day. I wish I could eat poultry dishes every day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon too!

choices.text: If you ate this every day...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I wouldn't if it was cooked by my mom.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I'm working hard to save money so that I can leave Yashiori Island, try more delicious food, and make yummy dishes for more people!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: It's said that only one round-trip route to Snezhnaya is still open in Ritou... Maybe I still have a chance.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: The grown-ups say that as long as I have enough Mora, even the Commissioner will let us go out to sea.

choices.text: Why did you change the subject?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: She left.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm sorry...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: It's okay. You must be curious, I know.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Ten days after it began to rain on the island, my mom left.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: She didn't leave me any letter or note...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: But for some reason, I already knew that she was going to leave. Especially the day when the grown-ups were setting up my dad's tombstone...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: That day, my mom was very angry. I've never seen her that angry... My mom believes that my dad's still alive. I believe that too.

choices.text: What was this place like before?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: ...You know, before the war, before the Shogunate shut down the mines... We lived happy lives.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: No one was starving. No one was poor... We'd share the food we couldn't finish with each other. Everyone would help to clean the rooms, houses... everything.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: The grown-ups all worked together in the mine, and they usually helped each other...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #Just like how you helped me, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: But now everyone's gone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...That's why you want to leave?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Mom should be searching for Dad... So I'm going to look for her, too.

choices.text: But where are you going to start?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I'll start on Yashiori Island, of course. Maybe I'll go ask the doctor called Yasumoto... But I think he hates me. He always hides from me every time he sees me from a distance...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: After that, I might go look for one of my dad's co-workers... I've heard that Mr. Kaji is still on the island. He might know something about Mom.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But there are lots of pirates out and about.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well... I guess I can seek help from the pirates, too... They don't get along with the grown-ups from the Shogunate, but they're nice to us.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: They might even agree to take me out to sea with them.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: And then... Well, not that man. He's scary.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Who now?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Washizu, the head of Higi Village. He used to be a very nice person... But now he's very strange.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: He's very scary. He always stares at my house from a distance and talks to himself. I always thought that he might do something bad to me... or to my mother.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I hope Mom didn't bump into him.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #Ah, speaking of Washizu... Can I ask you for one more favor, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well, Washizu built some shrines on the island way back when. They were originally meant to pacify the Serpent's soul with offerings...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: After all, we come into contact with Jakotsu Crystal all the time, and that makes people get sick after a while.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: But since the mine closed, Washizu has become weirder and scarier... The way he makes offerings at the shrine has also become more and more... crazy, I think.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Later on, the adults who were calling Washizu's behavior crazy started disappearing one by one...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Speaking of which, Mom used to go to the nearby shrine to pray for my dad and I. She'd offer some Sakura Bloom petals there too.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I want to go there and see if she's left any messages for me... But I'm afraid that I might bump into Washizu, so I can't get too close.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: So... So...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #Thank you so much, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: I'll go check it out for you.
Maybe she hasn't left the island yet...
The Shogunate isn't poking their nose around these parts, are they?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Once in a while, grown-ups from the city would come to buy ore. They liked to criticize us, too.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: But we do things our way. They have their rules in the city, and Her Excellency set rules for us as well...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: If not for the war, I would have had to participate in one of those "audits," though I don't know much about it.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: They say it's an obligation... But I don't like being with a whole group of adults. It's so boring.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Hello, we meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a minute. Let Paimon guess what you're about to say...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Please get me more Crystal Marrow..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Paimon needs them urgently, boo hoo..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's what you are going to say, right!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Hahaha, of course not!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have your travels been going?

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Good. But I still haven't found any trace of my Mom...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #It doesn't matter. We'll help you, too, right, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll do our best.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #Mm! I knew I could rely on you, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're back!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We've investigated the shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, your mother didn't leave any messages there...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But someone did leave a lot of Sakura Bloom petals there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's the flowers your mother offered.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry, Chouji. We couldn't find any more information...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: It's fine. I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #Thank you for your hard work over these last few days, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Now... I need to figure out what to do next.

choices.text: Aren't you going to find the Commissioner?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well... Thanks, but I won't. We don't trust the city folk.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Thanks, but I don't want to trouble you anymore.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: And... I don't want to be taken care of.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The kid is very grown-up for his age...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: It's not like that... It's just that... I've lost the person that I relied on, and I don't want to rely on others. That's all.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, if you've got family you're looking for, you should be able to understand me, right?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well... That makes a lot of sense. I'll keep it in mind.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Okay, I won't keep you any longer. I wish you a safe journey.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Soon, I will head out on my own journey...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Safe travels to you too, Chouji!

choices.text: But we should also cherish the reliable partners we find.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}! How've you been?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's been great, and you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You stole my line!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Haha, that's 'cause you're too slow!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, gunning for an extra meal, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course. Paimon could always go for an extra meal!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You misunderstand. I mean you're the extra meal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey now!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Pfft... Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: All right, all right, you guys, please stop fighting.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: I'm doing fine. But I'd like to ask you for another favor.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #Well, it's nothing special. I just need you to help me get some more crystals, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Believe me, I'll reward you for your help... As long as you trust me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I trust you, but...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: But...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right. We still don't know why you need so much Crystal Marrow!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well... I need money to travel so that I can find my mother, so I need to trade the crystals for money.

choices.text: But the Shogunate has monopolized the crystal market.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I know, but I'll find my own way!

choices.text: You're playing a dangerous game here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're friends, aren't we, Chouji?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe we can help you again, just like last time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, you promised that you'd reward us. So we have the right to know about things that might endanger your and thus affect our reward, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What a mercenary philosophy...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Pfft... Paimon's right, though.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I don't collect crystal entirely for money.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I've been thinking... What if Mom and Dad get the disease caused by the Tatarigami, just like everyone else?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Maybe these crystals can be used to make medicine. They grew from the bones of the giant serpent, after all...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: And Mr. Yasumoto also mentioned that these crystals may be useful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you can't be sure if that's correct, can you?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Maybe not, but we don't have anything else to go on.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: When I find Mom... or maybe even Dad, I'll take them to Sumeru. People say that they've got cure for this strange disease there.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Before that, I can't give up any hope of finding a treatment.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Well, I've said enough. Still want to help me?

choices.text: Do you even need to ask?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Thank you! I won't forget this!

choices.text: I hope you can make good use of the crystals.
You know that these crystals aren't easy to sell, don't you?
You promised to give me an explanation.
I'll see what I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Are you done? Let's have a try!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I think this'll do.)

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Uh... Ahaha, I've got to say that I've never tasted such... outlandish flavors in my life.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Outlandish flavors? More like Abyssal ones!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, Chouji, don't force yourself! You're still a kid. You don't have to eat this stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Hmmm... You don't seem to have had that much experience in the kitchen, but the food's still really good. Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Humph, {NICKNAME}'s culinary skill needs no praise! Hey, save some for Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: This should be enough Crystal Marrow. Now it's time to start my adventure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's still worried about this kid...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Yeah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, Chouji, you'd better stop running your mouth! You should feel lucky that you met us... otherwise, you'd get beaten up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also, in case any bad guys want to fish for any information from you, be sure not to tell them the truth! Make up a story!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And also...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon's turning into a naggy old granny.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyone would be worried if a little kid like him went out on an adventure all by himself!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I have faith in him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Hmph, sure you do.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Hahahaha! Thank you, thank you both!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I hope we'll meet again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Promise Paimon that you'll stay safe...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: I'll be fine!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Next, I'll head to Tatarasuna, where Mom used to work. Maybe someone can tell me if she's been there.

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: And then... I'll try to go to Narukami Island and travel to Snezhnaya via merchant ship. After that, I'll just see how things go.

choices.text: Do you know what you're talking about?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: If no one went on adventures because they didn't know all the risks... Well, there wouldn't be any adventurers in the world, would there?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, this kid is sooo irritating...

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Hahaha, don't you worry about me!

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: #You guys have a safe trip! By the way, {NICKNAME}, I hope that you can find your family soon, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup! Thank you!

choices.text: Do you understand the risks you're taking?

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #Hey there, {NICKNAME}, I didn't expect I'd see you again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Long time no see! How's the world outside of Yashiori Island?

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: It's a lot wealthier than my hometown. They have a lot of good food and fun things to do. But... I can't say that I really like it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? Why's that?

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: The people here all seem to be missing something...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: When we used to live in Yashiori Island, Her Excellency was a distant yet calming presence to us... We didn't care where she was, but we believed that she was right there, watching us, protecting us, deciding how we should live our lives and what kind of people we should become...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: But here, Her Excellency covers everything and oppresses everything...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm not really sure how to put it...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: By the way, have you found anything concerning my mother?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're still trying.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: It's okay. Tell me when you have any news.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Anyway. Thank you for your help! See you around!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #Well, I don't know when I'll see you again next. I hope you'll still remember me by then, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #Woohoo! Alright then, {NICKNAME}, you can start now!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #You're back, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Why don't you eat something, or drink some water?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Thank you!

choices.text: Let me finish your commission first.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: This is probably the shrine that Chouji mentioned, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (It looks like an ordinary shrine — there is a distinct lack of any strange elemental traces.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Investigate

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (The shrine is simple but elegant. Its wood shimmers slightly, greeting guests and their offerings with solemn silence.)

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (Many Sacred Sakura petals lie scattered around this shrine, though it is not a natural scene. Instead, it seems more like someone intentionally scattered the Sakura Blooms here.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... There aren't any traces here, either.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right. Chouji mentioned that his mom would present this offering to the shrine!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There are so many petals here, too... This can't be a coincidence.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go back and tell him!

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're back. Did you bring any Crystal Marrow back?

response.speaker: Chouji
response.text: Take your time. You can take a rest here too if you like.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We found a letter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Read it yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Well... Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: I'll read it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You might find her selfish...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But please don't blame her.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: ...I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: But I'll keep looking for her. Only when I find her can any of these things have meaning.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This child... is so stubborn.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Anyway. Thank you for your help! See you around!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We found a letter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Read it yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: Well... Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: I'll read it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You might find her selfish...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But please don't blame her.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: ...I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Chouji
dialogues.text: But I'll keep looking for her. Only when I find her can any of these things have meaning.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This child... is so stubborn.
